papers.published_version_access_note_initial_ro: All IOP URLs (article page, /pdf, legacy /2058-9565/11/1/015049/pdf, doi.org redirect) returned a Radware bot-manager captcha page to scripted requests on 2026-10-04; the Chrome extension was not connected; OpenAlex lists no repository copy of the published version; no Wayback snapshot.
papers.published_version_access_note: Follow-up audit (2026-10-04): one plain request to https://doi.org/10.1088/2058-9565/ae2202 was served the IOPscience article page with the open-access full text (no challenge was presented or solved), and one plain request to its citation_pdf_url served the version-of-record PDF (CC BY 4.0). The PDF carries a per-download stamp, so its sha256 is specific to this download.
papers.review_scope: arXiv v2 main text and Appendices A-D (27 pp.) read in full, including the LaTeX source; v1 compared by paragraph-level diff of the LaTeX sources and by numbering in the PDF.

files.role: version-of-record article page with full text (follow-up audit)

version_of_record.post_publication_change: Made 07 April 2026: Figure 2 had been replaced by a duplicate of Figure 3 during final file creation and was restored (note on the article page). The retrieved PDF shows the correct Figure 2.
version_of_record.pages: 24 journal pages (25 PDF pages incl. an IOP cover page); journal page = PDF page - 1
version_of_record.comparison_with_arxiv_v2: Paragraph-level 5-word-shingle comparison: 95.6% of version-of-record shingles occur in the v2 LaTeX source and 91.0% of v2 shingles occur in the version of record; the only paragraphs without a counterpart are publisher boilerplate (licence, post-publication-change note, data-availability statement) and author affiliations. Equation, figure, theorem, corollary, lemma and definition numbers are identical; sections use arabic instead of roman numerals.
version_of_record.comparison_with_arxiv_v1: 78.5% shingle coverage; the v2-only passages V-01 to V-03 are present in the version of record.
version_of_record.arxiv_v2_relation: arXiv v2 (2026-06-04) was posted 125 days after online publication (2026-01-30). The arXiv record carries the journal-ref 'Quantum Science and Technology, Volume 11, 015049 (2026)', the DOI and the comment '11+13 pages, 5 figures'; neither field states that v2 is the published or accepted text. A text comparison shows that v2 matches the version of record (see B5_VERSION_GAP.md).
